title: Minoa got ahead of  firefighter shortage. Will Onondaga County be next? (Guest Opinion by Don Lough)
summary: Guest opinion by retired Syracuse Fire Department lieutenant Don Lough advocates for proactive workforce planning in firefighting, citing Minoa's success in addressing firefighter shortages ahead of crisis. The piece signals need for Onondaga County and regional departments to adopt similar preventive hiring and retention strategies to avoid acute staffing gaps.

political_signal.description: Opinion piece advocating for workforce planning as critical public safety issue; frames proactive hiring as model for county-level adoption
